arxiv-1805-07819.title: Knowledge-enriched Two-layered Attention Network for Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-1805-07819.creator: Abhishek Kumar, Daisuke Kawahara, Sadao Kurohashi
arxiv-1805-07819.description: Abstract We propose a novel two-layered attention network based on Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory for sentiment analysis. The novel two-layered attention network takes advantage of the external knowledge bases to improve the sentiment prediction. It uses the Knowledge Graph Embedding generated using the WordNet.

arxiv-2204-09756.title: A Decentralized Analysis and Control Synthesis Approach for Networked Systems with Arbitrary Interconnections
arxiv-2204-09756.creator: Shirantha Welikala, Hai Lin, Panos Antsaklis
arxiv-2204-09756.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shirantha Welikala, Hai Lin, Panos Antsaklis. This paper considers the problem of decentralized analysis and control synthesis to verify and ensure properties like stability and dissipativity of a large-scale networked system comprised of linear subsystems interconnected in an arbitrary topology. In particular, we design systematic networked system analysis and control synthesis processes that can be executed in a decentralized manner at the subsystem level with minimal information sharing among the subsystems.

arxiv-2209-08361.creator: Tom Banks
arxiv-2209-08361.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tom Banks. The Holographic Space-time (HST) model of inflation has a potential explanation for dark matter as tiny primordial black holes. Motivated by a recent paper of Barrau [ 1 ] we propose a version of this model where some of the Inflationary Black Holes (IBHs), whose decay gives rise to the Hot Big Bang, carry the smallest value of a discrete symmetry charge.

arxiv-2301-01536.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by F. Torresi, J. Lasave, S. Koval. Path integral Monte Carlo (PIMC) simulations with very simple models were used in order to unveil the physics behind the isotope effects in H-bonded ferroelectrics. First, we studied geometrical effects in the H-bonds caused by deuteration with a general three-site model based on a back-to-back double Morse potential plus a Morse potential between oxygens, fitted to explain different general features for a wide set of H-bonded compounds.

arxiv-2310-10693.description: Abstract . In recent years, citizen science has become a larger and larger part of the scientific community. arxiv-2310-11405.title: On Coherence-based Predictors for Dense Query Performance Prediction
arxiv-2310-11405.creator: Maria Vlachou, Craig Macdonald
arxiv-2310-11405.description: Abstract . Query Performance Prediction (QPP) estimates the effectiveness of a search engine’s results in response to a query without relevance judgments. Traditionally, post-retrieval predictors have focused upon either the distribution of the retrieval scores, or the coherence of the top-ranked documents using traditional bag-of-words index representations.

arxiv-2412-05508.title: Optimizing Returns from Experimentation Programs
arxiv-2412-05508.creator: Timothy Sudijono, Simon Ejdemyr, Apoorva Lal, Martin Tingley
arxiv-2412-05508.description: Abstract Experimentation in online digital platforms is used to inform decision making. Specifically, the goal of many experiments is to optimize a metric of interest. Null hypothesis statistical testing can be ill-suited to this task, as it is indifferent to the magnitude of effect sizes and opportunity costs.

arxiv-2412-18256.title: Robust Semi-Supervised Learning in Open Environments
arxiv-2412-18256.creator: Lan-Zhe Guo, Lin-Han Jia, Jie-Jing Shao, *
arxiv-2412-18256.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning (SSL) aims to improve performance by exploiting unlabeled data when labels are scarce. Conventional SSL studies typically assume close environments where important factors (e.g., label, feature, distribution) between labeled and unlabeled data are consistent. However, more practical tasks involve open environments where important factors between labeled and unlabeled data are inconsistent.

pmc-10711718.description: Beta activity is thought to play a critical role in sensorimotor processes. However, little is known about how activity in this frequency band develops. uslaw-usc-t36-s21704a.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 217 (The American Legion). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
